purpose: Route identifiers and vehicle appearance must generalize beyond the private 912 demonstration.

cases.focus: Changing electronic destination display; do not require the destination wording to stay fixed.

cases.file: Arriva London LJ08CXR in Addiscombe Road, Croydon (February 2016).webm
cases.focus: Unseen vehicle, route and country; moving bus.
Unseen articulated bus; fleet identifier must not be treated as route.

acceptance.positive: One target_observed event while independently annotated route is legible; report failure if missed.
acceptance.negative: Zero target_observed events for every negative target over the whole clip.
acceptance.association: Route and direction evidence must belong to the same detected vehicle.
acceptance.direction: When a direction is requested but unreadable, emit candidate information without confirming the requested service.
acceptance.split: Freeze labels and targets before inference; tuning on a holdout result invalidates its holdout status. Preserve first-pass results.
acceptance.limits: Three public clips are a small exploratory check, not a deployment accuracy estimate. Synthetic text fixtures test logic only.
